about: Tests that fail on a target for a known reason that is not a bug in that target. summarize.mjs prints the class next to the failure and does not count it as a regression. An entry matches by file and full title, and only for the targets and modes it names (all when left out).

classes.emulator-hello-host: The emulator names its own plain-http bind address in the hello (h), where the SDK sends later connections; behind TLS they fail. The TLS front rewrites it unless RTDB_EMULATOR_HELLO=keep, so these fail only then.
classes.assumes-firebaseio: The test only works with a *.firebaseio.com databaseURL.
classes.needs-real-project: The test needs a real Firebase project or Google service.
classes.timing: The test depends on timing the target cannot be expected to match.

tests.title: Database@exp Tests blocks get requests until the database is online
tests.why: goOnline() reconnects to the hello's h, 127.0.0.1:9470, with TLS. Fails only with RTDB_EMULATOR_HELLO=keep (emulator 4.11.2, 2026-10-20).

tests.title: ServerValue tests resolves timestamps locally
tests.why: The test needs the server's timestamp to differ from the SDK's local estimate (Date.now() + serverTimeOffset), so that two value events fire. Aruma on loopback acks within the same millisecond, on the same clock, so the two are equal and the SDK raises one event (2026-10-20). Over a real network, or against the slower emulator, they differ.
